    "are prepared and ready before the start of business on the next "

    "provisioned, configured, and ready for use.\\n"

    "and operational.\\n\\n"
    "All three items need to be in place before the start of business on "
    "the next business day, per the timeline specified in Olivia's "
    "communication to Ethan.\\n\\n"
    "Please let me know if you need any additional information or if there "
    "are any issues that might affect this timeline. Your prompt attention "
    "to this request is greatly appreciated.\\n\\n"
    "Thank you"
)

email = EmailMessage()
email["From"] = sender + "@example.com"
email["To"] = recipient + "@example.com"
email["Subject"] = subject
email.set_content(body)

for folder in [sender, recipient]:
    d = os.path.join(TESTBED, "emails", folder)
    os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
    fp = os.path.join(d, subject + ".eml")
    with open(fp, "w") as f:
        f.write(email.as_string())
    print(f"Saved: {fp}")

print("Done - email delivered to both sender and recipient folders.")
"""
